problems.constraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 30000; up to 30000 calls; values fit in signed int.

examples.explanation: The initial full range sums to 9.
The array becomes [1,2,5].

problems.optimizedComplexity: update Time O(log n), sumRange Time O(log n); Space O(n). Fenwick tree stores prefix deltas.
